about: Hand-written rotation guides for the rogue's player pages (guides.py). Every bold name is a rogue spell or talent. Stamp with: python _reference/data/guides.py --stamp rogue

raid.plan: Combat in a raid is a dagger rotation run on energy: **Backstab** from behind builds combo points, **Slice and Dice** stays up, and 4 or more points go into **Eviscerate**. **Shank** goes on cooldown for energy, **Blade Flurry** before the pull and again when it is back, **Adrenaline Rush** once a fight.
why: **Slice and Dice** comes first: 30% more attack speed, and white hits are 45% of this build's damage in a full raid. Put it back up the moment it drops, even with 1 combo point: it lasts 9 seconds at 1 point and 21 at 5, and **Improved Slice and Dice** makes that 45% longer. The list never refreshes it early: while it is up, your points go into **Eviscerate**.

**Eviscerate** goes at 4 or more points, and at 3 when **Slice and Dice** has 6 seconds or less left. Waiting for 5 wastes points: **Puncturing Wounds** gives **Backstab** a 45% chance to add a second point, and **Ruthlessness** adds a point after 60% of your finishers; the rotation search measured finishing at 4 rather than 5 0.6% better. **Flawless Execution** cuts its cost from 35 to 20 energy, and **Coup de Grace** and **Aggression** add 20% and 15% to its damage.

**Shank** costs 5 energy and gives back 25; **Flash of Steel** adds 15 more and takes its cooldown from 10 to 8 seconds. Press it whenever it is ready and you have 80 energy or less (about 23 times in a 3-minute fight). In the simulator this build loses 8% of its damage without **Flash of Steel**, more than without any other talent but **Puncturing Wounds** (10%).

**Adrenaline Rush** doubles your energy regeneration for 15 seconds on a 5-minute cooldown: once a fight, with **Slice and Dice** up and 50 energy or less, so little of the extra energy is lost at the cap. **Blade Flurry** (20% more attack speed for 15 seconds, 2-minute cooldown) goes 3 seconds before the pull and again when it comes back: twice in a 3-minute fight.

**Backstab** is your only builder and your filler: 60 energy, from behind, with a dagger in your main hand; about 38 a fight and 30% of your damage. **Opportunity** adds 20% to its damage, **Lethality** 20% to its crit damage, **Puncturing Wounds** 30% to its crit chance, and **Hack and Slash** gives you 4% crit with daggers.
caveats: **Backstab** needs a dagger in your main hand and you behind the target. If you cannot get behind the boss, build with **Sinister Strike**; with a sword, take the swords setup this page links (21/30/0), which plays that way.

**Garrote** is on the list, but it only works from stealth: the simulator presses **Vanish** a second into the fight and opens a **Garrote** right after, once a fight (**Vanish** has a 5-minute cooldown). Starting the fight in **Stealth** was not simulated.
While **Blade Flurry** is up, your attacks also strike a second nearby target: with adds, it is your cleave.
diverge: In the last 6 seconds, skip **Slice and Dice** and put any combo points, even 1, into **Eviscerate**: a buff that outlives the boss does nothing.

If no warrior keeps Sunder Armor on the target (a small group or a dungeon), keep **Expose Armor** up at 5 points. The simulator's list has a switch for it, off in a raid; an earlier search on the training dummy, where nothing else lowers armor, measured about 10% from it.

leveling.plan: Combat levels on short fights with two swords: open with **Garrote** from stealth, build to 5 points with **Sinister Strike**, finish with **Eviscerate**, press **Shank** and **Riposte** whenever they are ready, and put **Cold Blood** before an **Eviscerate** from level 55. Fights are too short for **Slice and Dice** or **Cheap Shot** to pay.
why: Open with **Garrote** (learned at 14) from stealth behind the mob: a combo point and an 18-second bleed. The tuned rules never open with **Cheap Shot** (about 6% faster per kill without it): it gives points and a stun but no damage, for 60 energy.

**Sinister Strike** builds to 5 points and **Eviscerate** finishes. **Efficient Strikes** (levels 14 and 22) cut **Sinister Strike** by 5 energy, **Flawless Execution** (25) cuts **Eviscerate** by 15, and **Coup de Grace** (10-12) and **Aggression** (28-30) make the hits harder. Cast **Eviscerate** earlier when it would kill the mob, because points left on a dead mob are lost.
**Riposte** (talent, level 21) lights up after you parry: 10 energy for 150% weapon damage and a 6-second disarm. It is your cheapest hit, so press it as soon as it lights up.

**Shank** (level 24) strikes with your off hand for 5 energy, cannot miss and gives 15 energy back on a 10-second cooldown (25 energy from rank 2 at 44). **Flash of Steel** (35-39) adds up to 15 more energy and cuts the cooldown by 2 seconds, so press it on cooldown unless the energy would go over your maximum.
**Cold Blood** (talent, level 55) makes your next **Eviscerate** a sure critical strike. Its cooldown is 3 minutes, so it comes up about every eighth pull: press it at 5 points whenever it is ready.
Skip **Slice and Dice**: in fights this short it does not pay back its energy and the points it takes from **Eviscerate** (about 4% to 5% faster per kill without it).
Pull the next mob within 20 seconds of a kill: **Remorseless Attacks** (levels 40-41) gives your next **Sinister Strike** 40% more crit chance.
caveats: This build has no **Blade Flurry** or **Adrenaline Rush** (the list above leaves their line out) and no **Setup**, so **Evasion** is your only cooldown when a pull goes wrong.

**Improved Expose Armor** (54) opens **Venom** (60), which makes each **Shank** strengthen your poisons for 6 seconds; it and **Improved Slice and Dice** (57-59) improve spells this list never casts, and **Improved Poisons** (56) only helps your poisons.
**Kidney Shot** is not in the list: the tuned rules never cast it (under 1% faster per kill). Keep it for an add or a pull that goes wrong.

With swords the tuned rules never **Kick** (about 0.5% to 1% faster per kill): a caster mob that stays back walks in once it has cast. **Backstab** and **Ambush** need a dagger, so they are not in the list.
Eat only below 40% health and bandage below 60%: the tuned rules measured eating that late about 4.5% faster per kill.
diverge: Below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health, press **Evasion** (50% more dodge for 15 seconds).
In long fights such as dungeon bosses, **Slice and Dice** may pay again: the fight lab only plays solo mobs.
If a pull goes wrong, **Gouge**, **Kidney Shot**, **Vanish** and **Sprint** get you out; the fight lab does not model adds or escapes.

raid.plan: Assassination in a raid is a Mutilate rotation: **Mutilate** builds combo points two at a time, **Slice and Dice** stays up, and every 3 or more points go into **Eviscerate**. **Shank** goes on cooldown to keep **Venom** going, and **Vanish** opens one **Garrote** early in the fight.
why: **Slice and Dice** is 30% more attack speed: more white hits (35% of your damage in a full raid) and more chances for your poisons, which can proc on every weapon strike. Put it back up the moment it drops, even with 1 combo point; the list never refreshes it early.

**Eviscerate** goes at 3 or more points: **Mutilate** brings 2 at once, **Seal Fate** adds a third when it crits (**Puncturing Wounds** gives **Mutilate** 15% more crit chance), and **Ruthlessness** adds a point after 60% of your finishers, so waiting for 5 wastes points. The rotation search measured 3 or more 0.6% better than 5.

Each **Eviscerate** pays for itself: **Flawless Execution** cuts its cost from 35 to 20 energy, and **Relentless Strikes** gives each combo point a 20% chance to restore 25 energy. In the simulator these are the build's two most valuable talents (removing **Relentless Strikes** costs 12% of its damage, **Flawless Execution** 8%). **Coup de Grace** and **Aggression** add 20% and 15% to **Eviscerate**, about a quarter of your damage.

**Mutilate** is your builder and filler: 60 energy, both weapons, 2 combo points, 20% more damage against a poisoned target; about 36 a fight and 20% of your damage. Its tooltip, unlike **Backstab**'s, does not ask you to stand behind the target. **Malice** and **Lethality** make its crits more frequent and bigger, and every crit feeds **Seal Fate**.

**Shank** goes on its 10-second cooldown at 80 energy or less: it costs 5 energy, gives back 25, and with **Venom** raises your poison damage by 30% and your chance to apply poisons by 20% for 6 seconds (removing **Venom** costs 7%). Poisons are 18% of your damage in a full raid: **Instant Poison** on the main hand, **Deadly Poison** on the off hand, with **Vile Poisons** adding 20% to their damage and **Improved Poisons** 2% to their chance to land.
caveats: **Garrote** is on the list, but it only works from stealth: the simulator presses **Vanish** a second into the fight and opens a **Garrote** right after, once a fight (**Vanish** has a 5-minute cooldown; that **Garrote** is under 1% of your damage). Starting the fight in **Stealth** was not simulated.
There is no **Expose Armor** in the list: in a full raid a warrior keeps Sunder Armor on the boss, and the two do not stack (only the stronger one counts).

The list ends with **Backstab**, but this build never casts it: **Mutilate** is the builder whenever you have under 5 points. Blizzard built Forever's Assassination around **Mutilate** and **Venom**, and the simulator agrees: our hand-made Seal Fate **Backstab** build (28/21/2) did 687 DPS in a full raid against this build's 813.
Poisons now go on a weapon together with a sharpening stone (Blizzard's rogue deep dive, 2026-10-07), so use both.
diverge: In the last 6 seconds, start no **Slice and Dice**: keep putting 3 or more points into **Eviscerate** even with it down.

If no warrior keeps Sunder Armor on the target (a small group or a dungeon), keep **Expose Armor** up. The simulator's list has a switch for it, off in a raid: at 5 points, renew it when it has 16 seconds or less left, before any other finisher. An earlier search on the training dummy, where nothing else lowers armor, measured about 9% from it.

leveling.plan: Assassination levels with two daggers: **Garrote** from stealth, **Sinister Strike** to 5 points, then **Eviscerate**, until **Mutilate** takes over as the builder at level 40. **Venom** (30) is its prerequisite, so the tree buys it first; **Mutilate**, **Seal Fate** and the poison talents are what set it apart.
why: A mob you fight alone turns to face you after the opener, and **Backstab** needs you behind it, so the builder is **Sinister Strike** until you have **Mutilate**. It cannot come earlier: it sits at the bottom of the tree behind **Venom**, and the 31st point of the tree is level 40.

**Mutilate** hits with both weapons for 90% weapon damage plus a flat amount each, 20% more on a poisoned mob, and gives 2 combo points for 60 energy: wait for the energy rather than fall back to **Sinister Strike**. **Seal Fate** (35-37) makes its crits add a second point.

Open with **Garrote** from stealth: a combo point and an 18-second bleed (**Blood Splatter** at 24 makes it 9 seconds longer). The tuned rules never open with **Cheap Shot** (about 8% faster per kill without it): it gives points and a stun but no damage, for 60 energy.

**Eviscerate** at 5 points, or earlier when it would kill the mob: points left on a dead mob are lost. **Cold Blood** (talent, level 25) makes the next **Sinister Strike**, **Mutilate** or **Eviscerate** a sure critical strike, but its cooldown is 3 minutes, about every eighth pull: press it right before an **Eviscerate** at 5 points so a builder does not use it up.
**Shank** (level 24) is a free strike that gives energy back every 10 seconds; with **Venom** (30) each **Shank** also makes your poisons hit 30% harder and land 20% more often for 6 seconds.

Keep **Instant Poison** on the main hand and **Deadly Poison** (level 30) on the off hand: every weapon strike can apply them, and **Deadly Poison** keeps the target poisoned for **Mutilate**'s bonus. **Vile Poisons** (26) and **Improved Poisons** (27-29, 32) make both stronger.

**Relentless Strikes** (31-39) refunds 25 energy on some finishers and **Ruthlessness** (15-17) adds a point back; **Malice**, **Lethality** and **Remorseless Attacks** make the crits frequent. Pull the next mob within 20 seconds of a kill so the 40% crit chance from **Remorseless Attacks** is not wasted.
Skip **Slice and Dice**: fights end before it pays back (about 3% faster per kill without it).
caveats: Keep daggers in both hands: the build plays daggers, and **Mutilate** strikes with both weapons.
The points after level 40 go to Combat's talents (**Coup de Grace**, **Puncturing Wounds**, **Precision**, **Aggression**): they make **Eviscerate** and **Mutilate** hit harder and land more often.
**Kidney Shot** is not in the list: the tuned rules never cast it (under 1% faster per kill). Keep it for an add or a pull that goes wrong.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell: with daggers the tuned rules keep it.
This build has no **Blade Flurry**, **Adrenaline Rush** or **Riposte**, so **Evasion** is your only cooldown when a pull goes wrong.
Eat only below 40% health and bandage below 60%: the tuned rules measured eating that late about 4.2% faster per kill.
diverge: Below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health, press **Evasion** (50% more dodge for 15 seconds).
In a dungeon, where the tank holds the mob, stand behind it and build with **Backstab**; the fight lab only plays solo.

raid.plan: Subtlety in a raid is a Death Mark rotation: **Hemorrhage** and **Shank** build combo points, **Garrote** and **Rupture** stay on the boss, **Slice and Dice** stays up, and 4 or more points go into **Death Mark**, which stores part of your damage and deals it a second time. The list never casts **Eviscerate**.
why: **Death Mark** is your main finisher: 25 energy, a 10-second cooldown, at 4 or more points. For 6 seconds it stores a portion of the damage you deal the target per combo point, **Garrote** and **Rupture** damage at twice the rate, then deals what it stored, up to a maximum your attack power and crit chance raise. **Coup de Grace** raises its damage and storage rate by 20%. It is 23% of your damage in a full raid (about 14 a fight); with it in the build, the simulator's list spends no points on **Eviscerate**.

**Ghostly Strike** lets your next **Garrote** within 7 seconds skip stealth, so **Garrote** stays on the boss all fight: **Ghostly Strike** when **Garrote** has 4 seconds or less left, then **Garrote** when it runs out (about 7 a fight, 10% of your damage). **Blood Splatter** makes **Garrote** last 27 seconds instead of 18, **Dirty Deeds** makes it 20 energy cheaper and usable from the front, **Initiative** adds a second combo point to it, and **Opportunity** adds 20% to its damage.

**Rupture** goes on whenever it is off and you have 3 or more points (about 8 a fight, 10% of your damage). **Serrated Blades** adds 30% to it (and your attacks ignore 9% of armor), **Hemorrhage** adds 15% to **Rupture** and **Garrote** for 15 seconds, and **Blood Splatter** makes **Rupture** last 6 seconds longer.

**Hemorrhage** is your filler (35 energy, 30 with **Efficient Strikes**; 145% weapon damage with a dagger in your main hand), and the list renews it whenever its 15-second effect has run out. **Shank** costs 5 energy, gives back 25, and with **Boot Knife** adds 2 combo points: press it when it is ready, with 3 or fewer points and 80 energy or less.

Below 5 points the list keeps building; at 5, with **Death Mark** on cooldown and **Rupture** and **Slice and Dice** up, it waits. It also holds **Hemorrhage** while **Garrote** has under 6 seconds left, so the energy is there for **Ghostly Strike** and the new **Garrote** (the rotation search measured that 0.5% better than holding from 8 seconds). **Slice and Dice** (30% attack speed) goes back up with 1 point whenever it drops.

**Premeditation** adds 2 points: before the pull, then on its 2-minute cooldown with 3 or fewer points (the simulator needs no stealth for it, and its beta tooltip asks for none). **Vanish** opens a **Garrote** a second into the fight, and **Preparation** finishes the cooldowns of **Vanish** and **Premeditation** once a fight. Each of the two talents measured about 1% in the simulator.
caveats: The **Garrote** after **Vanish** needs stealth, and damage you take breaks it; the simulator does not model that. If something hits you right after **Vanish**, the next **Ghostly Strike** opens the **Garrote** instead.

Almost all of this works from the front: **Hemorrhage**, **Ghostly Strike**, **Death Mark**, **Rupture**, and **Garrote** with **Dirty Deeds**. Only **Ambush** and **Backstab** need you behind the target, and the list casts neither.
Subtlety has no cleave: on adds, stay on the kill target, and do not **Rupture** a target that dies within 8 seconds.
diverge: In the last 6 seconds, start no **Rupture** and no **Slice and Dice**: they would outlast the boss.

Without a warrior's Sunder Armor on the boss, keep **Expose Armor** up at 5 points; the simulator's list has a switch for it, off in a raid. An earlier search on the training dummy measured it about 2.5% better.
The simulator starts every fight out of stealth. In the game you can start in **Stealth** and open with **Garrote** at the pull; that opener was not simulated.

leveling.plan: Subtlety levels on its openers and on dodges: **Premeditation** (24) and a stealth opener put up to 4 points on the mob, a builder makes 5, and **Eviscerate** or **Death Mark** ends the fight. **Ghostly Strike** (25) and **Hemorrhage** (30) are the signature strikes, and **Setup** (12-14) turns the mob's dodged swings into combo points.
why: From stealth, **Premeditation** (level 24) adds 2 points (a 2-minute cooldown, so about every fifth pull) and **Initiative** (23, 26-27) makes your opener add a second one: up to 4 points before your first builder.

Open with **Ambush** on most pulls at levels 18-21, while fights are short and its burst wins (**Opportunity** makes it hit harder). From about level 22 the mob lives long enough for the 18-second bleed of **Garrote** to pay, and the fight lab opens with **Garrote** on almost every pull: the bleed ignores armor, and **Dirty Deeds** (15-16) makes it 20 energy cheaper and usable from the front. **Improved Ambush** (18-19, 33) adds crit to those early **Ambush** openers and is a tier point after that: it measured nothing at 60.

**Ghostly Strike** (level 25) goes in on its 20-second cooldown: 180% weapon damage with a dagger, 1 combo point, 15% more dodge for 7 seconds, and your next **Ambush** or **Garrote** in that time needs no stealth. **Hemorrhage** (level 30) replaces **Sinister Strike** as the builder: 35 energy for 145% weapon damage with a dagger.
With **Setup** (12-14, 45% at 3 ranks), a dodge can add a combo point, so **Ghostly Strike**, **Lightning Reflexes** and **Evasion** also build points.
**Shank** (level 24) is a free strike that gives energy back; **Boot Knife** (35-39) adds 2 combo points to a **Shank** with 20% a rank, a sure 2 at 39, so it is a builder too.

**Death Mark** (talent, level 40; 25 energy, 10-second cooldown) is a finisher that stores part of your damage and deals it 6 seconds later; **Coup de Grace** (41-43) makes it store 20% more. The tuned rule presses it from 1 combo point on, while the mob has more than 40% of its health. At 5 points otherwise, wait for the energy for **Eviscerate** rather than press a builder whose point would be lost, and cast it earlier when it would kill the mob.

Skip **Slice and Dice** (about 5% faster per kill without it). **Kidney Shot** is not in the list: the tuned rules never cast it (under 1% faster per kill). Keep it for an add or a pull that goes wrong.
caveats: **Ambush** needs a dagger in your main hand and you behind the mob, and **Ghostly Strike** and **Hemorrhage** hit much harder with a dagger: keep daggers in both hands.
This build has no **Remorseless Attacks**, **Riposte** or **Blade Flurry**, so the list has no **Riposte** line.

**Master of Deception**, **Dirty Tricks** (34, which opens **Boot Knife** and **Death Mark**) and **Puncturing Wounds** (51-52, which opens **Aggression**, **Flawless Execution** and **Weapon Expertise**) are tier points on the way down the tree: the fight lab plays none of them.
**Rupture** is not in the leveling list: the fight lab plays **Eviscerate** and **Death Mark**, so **Serrated Blades** counts here for the armor it ignores and as the prerequisite of **Hemorrhage**.
Eat only below 40% health and bandage below 60%: the tuned rules measured eating that late about 4.5% faster per kill.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell: the tuned rules keep it.
diverge: Below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health, press **Evasion** (50% more dodge for 15 seconds, and with **Setup** more combo points). If it is on cooldown, **Preparation** (31) resets it.
If a pull goes wrong, **Vanish** gets you out; the fight lab does not model adds or escapes.

leveling.plan: Daggers (split) plays the dagger leveling list: **Garrote** from stealth, **Sinister Strike** to 5 points until **Mutilate** (level 40) takes over, then **Eviscerate**. Its last Subtlety points buy **Setup** and **Initiative**, which add combo points from dodges and from the opener.
why: A mob you fight alone turns to face you after the opener, and **Backstab** needs you behind it, so the builder is **Sinister Strike** until you have **Mutilate**.

**Mutilate** hits with both daggers and gives 2 combo points for 60 energy, 20% more damage on a mob with your **Deadly Poison**: wait for the energy rather than fall back to **Sinister Strike**. The fight lab measured it about 1.2 seconds per kill at 60.

**Eviscerate** at 5 points, or earlier when it would kill the mob. At 5 points **Relentless Strikes** always refunds 25 energy and **Ruthlessness** often adds a point back; press **Cold Blood** right before an **Eviscerate**, since your next builder would use it up otherwise.

Skip **Slice and Dice** (about 3% faster per kill without it). **Kidney Shot** is not in the list: the tuned rules never cast it (under 1% faster per kill). Keep it for an add or a pull that goes wrong. **Kick** a caster mob's spell.
Pull the next mob within 20 seconds of a kill: **Remorseless Attacks** gives your next builder 40% more crit chance.
caveats: **Master of Deception**, **Improved Ambush** and **Elusiveness** are only there to reach **Setup** and **Initiative**: this list never opens with **Ambush**.
Keep daggers in both hands: **Mutilate** needs them.
This build has no **Blade Flurry** or **Adrenaline Rush**: **Evasion** is your only cooldown for a bad pull.
Eat only below 40% health and bandage below 60%: the tuned rules measured eating that late about 4.2% faster per kill.
diverge: Below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health, press **Evasion** (50% more dodge for 15 seconds, and with **Setup** more combo points).
In a dungeon, where the tank holds the mob, stand behind it and build with **Backstab**; the fight lab only plays solo.

**Sinister Strike** is your builder all the way to 59: **Hemorrhage** needs 3 ranks of **Serrated Blades** behind it and arrives with the last point, at 60. **Efficient Strikes** (34-35) cut **Sinister Strike**'s cost by 5.

**Ghostly Strike** (level 25) goes in on its 20-second cooldown: 180% weapon damage with a dagger, 15% more dodge for 7 seconds. With **Setup** (1 rank at 12, 15%; all 3 by 59, 45%) a dodge sometimes adds a combo point.

caveats: Skip **Slice and Dice** (about 5% faster per kill without it). **Kidney Shot** is not in the list: the tuned rules never cast it (under 1% faster per kill). Keep it for an add or a pull that goes wrong.
Keep a dagger in your main hand: **Ambush** needs one, and **Ghostly Strike** and **Hemorrhage** hit much harder with it.

This build has no **Riposte**, **Preparation**, **Death Mark**, **Boot Knife** or **Relentless Strikes**: the list drops the lines that lead with them, and where it still names **Boot Knife** or **Preparation**, that part does not apply. **Evasion** is your only cooldown when a pull goes wrong.
Eat only below 40% health and bandage below 60%: the tuned rules measured eating that late about 4.5% faster per kill.
**Kick** a caster mob's spell: the tuned rules keep it.
diverge: Below half health while the mob still has more than 30% of its health, press **Evasion** (50% more dodge for 15 seconds, and with **Setup** sometimes a combo point).
If a pull goes wrong, **Vanish** gets you out; the fight lab does not model adds or escapes.
